final_message:
Fixed. The bug was in `_eligible` in `billing/discounts.py`. For plan-restricted coupons it checked `price_id is None and ...`, so only lines with no price could ever qualify. Real plan lines never did, and the discount came out as 0. I changed it to `price_id is not None and ...`.

The full suite now passes (25 tests). I added your reproducing test as `tests/test_plan_coupon.py`. I also wrote `answer.json` in the repo root: `{"file": "discounts.py", "function": "_eligible"}`.

steps.command: cd billing && ls && cat discounts.py && grep -n "discount\|applies_to" *.py | grep -v "^discounts.py" | head -50

cd .. && sed -i 's/return price_id is None and plan_of/return price_id is not None and plan_of/' billing/discounts.py && echo '{"file": "discounts.py", "function": "_eligible"}' > answer.json && grep -n "def plan_lookup" -A12 billing/invoices.py; cat >> tests/test_plan_coupon.py <<'EOF'
from billing import discounts


def test_plan_restricted_coupon(world):
    cus = world.customer()
    coupon = discounts.create_coupon(world.ctx, "team", percent_off=5000, applies_to_plans=[world.team["id"]])
    world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1), (world.team_monthly["id"], 1)], coupon_id=coupon["id"])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert [line["discount_amount"] for line in inv["lines"]] == [0, 1500]
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -8
